measures.what: outer diameter of the board, and its thickness
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the two small holes near the centre: hole diameter, distance between hole centres, and are they on a line through the board's centre (and at what angle relative to where the input wires leave)?
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: back face: tallest thing sticking out (connector, parts) and where the 4-pin connector sits (distance from centre)
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12

measures.what: length, width, thickness; corner hole diameter and centre-to-centre spacing along both sides; height of tallest part above top face and how far solder joints stick out below
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: USB-C port: which board edge it faces, how far its mouth is from that board edge (inside or overhanging), its centre's offset from the board's centre along that edge, and its centre height above the perfboard top face
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.item: wall screws and USB-C charger plug
measures.what: wall screw head diameter and shank diameter; USB-C plug overmould width and thickness (the plastic grip behind the metal)
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most

measures.what: diameter with a ruler or tape across the widest point (approximate is fine), and the height of the 4-pin connector/tallest part on its back face
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: Does the USB-C port face one of the perfboard's short (50 mm) edges? Does the port mouth stick out past the perfboard edge or sit inside it, and by how much? Is the ESP32 centred across the 50 mm width (if not, how far is its centreline from the board's centre, toward which side)?
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: width and thickness of the plastic grip behind the metal plug, and length of the metal part
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.what: Looking at the top of the perfboard with the ESP32's USB-C port pointing towards you: is the USB-C port left or right of the ESP32's centre line? And how far is the ESP32's left long edge from the perfboard's left long edge?
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: Does the metal USB-C port stick out past the ESP32's own board edge (towards the perfboard edge), or is it set back inside the ESP32's outline?
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge
